free_tier.stated: no service and no account; a small C program

egress.terms: not applicable; the software states no volume; ingress: tcp

chaining: composes with a host at each end and nothing else.
binding_note: the constraint is a host at each end, and it is the oldest and thinnest example of that requirement
reliability_note: unauthenticated by design; predates WireGuard and inherits none of its protections at the transport layer
confidence_note: the repository README was not read; the description and the WireGuard limitations page are the evidence, so a read of the source would raise it to documented

evidence.proved: repository description "Tunnel UDP packets in a TCP connection"; 222 stars; last push 2024-04-22; no releases
WireGuard names udptunnel alongside udp2raw as a project that can transform its UDP packets into TCP

notes: It predates WireGuard and has no TLS, no authentication and no multiplexing, so the only reason to reach for it over udp2raw or wg-tcp-tunnel is simplicity. Its README was not opened; the rung says so.

extras.wg_detail: "Tunnel UDP packets in a TCP connection"; one side listens for TCP, the other for UDP, and WireGuard's endpoint points at the UDP side
extras.volume_stated: not applicable; the software states no volume
extras.transit_note: through the server half to the UDP listener
extras.hosting_requirement: two hosts, one listening on TCP and one forwarding to the local UDP port
